urls.title: Video URLs
urls.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, MPEG-TS and anything else FFmpeg reads), one per line. Apify key-value store record URLs are read with your token. YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other social or video-platform links, web pages and streaming playlists (.m3u8) are refused with a free error.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to Video URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. a file with one URL per line, or the output of another actor). Combined with Video URLs.

keyValueStoreRecords.title: Key-value store records
keyValueStoreRecords.description: Videos uploaded to an Apify key-value store, as storeId/recordKey or username~store-name/recordKey, one per line. Use this for your own videos without hosting them anywhere.

mode.title: Frames
mode.description: Interval: frames every N seconds, or N evenly spaced frames. Scene changes: one frame at the start of each detected scene (costs $0.01 per started video minute for the analysis). Metadata only: no frames, just video info and the optional GIF and audio.

intervalSeconds.title: Every N seconds
intervalSeconds.description: Interval mode: one frame every this many seconds, starting at 0:00. Ignored when Number of frames is set.

frameCount.title: Number of frames
frameCount.description: Interval mode: this many frames, evenly spaced over the whole video (e.g. 12 thumbnails). 0 to use Every N seconds instead.

sceneThreshold.title: Scene sensitivity threshold (%)
sceneThreshold.description: Scene mode: how different a frame must be from the previous one to start a new scene, 1-99. Lower finds more (subtle) cuts; 30 suits most edited videos, 40-50 only hard cuts.

minSceneSeconds.title: Minimum scene length (seconds)
minSceneSeconds.description: Scene mode: cuts closer than this to the previous one are ignored (flashes, fast montages). 0 keeps every cut.

maxFrames.title: Max frames per video
maxFrames.description: Caps cost per video ($0.003 per frame). Interval mode spreads this many frames over the video when more would be needed; scene mode keeps the strongest cuts.

frameFormat.title: Image format
frameFormat.description: JPEG: small, universal. PNG: lossless, large. WebP: smallest at the same quality.

frameQuality.title: Quality
frameQuality.description: JPEG and WebP quality, 1-100 (ignored for PNG).

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Frames wider than this are scaled down (aspect ratio kept, never upscaled). 0 keeps the original size.

contactSheet.title: Contact sheet
contactSheet.description: Also save one grid image of all frames (320 px tiles, up to 20 rows), billed as one frame.

contactSheetColumns.title: Contact sheet columns
contactSheetColumns.description: Tiles per row of the contact sheet.

gifClip.title: GIF clip
gifClip.description: Also save a short animated GIF from the video ($0.005).

gifDurationSeconds.title: GIF length (seconds)
gifDurationSeconds.description: Length of the GIF clip, at most 15 s.

gifWidth.title: GIF width (px)
gifWidth.description: GIF width (never upscaled). GIFs get large fast: 320-480 is typical.

gifFps.title: GIF frames per second
gifFps.description: Frames per second of the GIF clip.

audioFormat.title: Extract audio track
audioFormat.description: Also save the video's audio track ($0.005): M4A (AAC 128 kbps), MP3 (VBR ~190 kbps) or Opus (96 kbps). A track already in that codec (e.g. AAC in an MP4, for M4A) is copied without re-encoding. Videos without audio get a warning and no charge.

maxDurationMinutes.title: Max video length (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.description: Longer videos are skipped with an error (free). At most 180.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger downloads are skipped with an error (free).

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to download one video.
